units.source_text: 男人吃吃地笑着，脱了鞋。

en.t: The man chuckled and took off his shoes.

units.source_text: 时间确实像横向流动的。

en.t: Time really did seem to flow sideways.

units.source_text: 他再也无法忍受鞋子中积存的沙子和汗水。

en.t: He could no longer stand the sand and sweat that had collected inside his shoes.

units.source_text: 脱了鞋，叉开脚趾迎着风。

en.t: He took off his shoes and spread his toes into the wind.

units.source_text: 然而，动物笼子这玩意儿，无论如何总会发出难闻的气味吧？

en.t: Still, an animal cage is bound to give off a bad smell no matter what, isn't it?

units.source_text: ……即使有花一般气味的动物，看来也没有任何影响……

en.t: ...Even if there were animals that smelled like flowers, it seemed that would make no difference at all...
No, this is the smell of my own feet...

units.source_text: 这么一想，心里竟忽然涌起阵阵亲切感，真奇怪呀……

en.t: Thinking that, he strangely felt waves of affection suddenly welling up inside him...

units.source_text: 记不清是谁，有个家伙竟然说，

en.t: He could not remember who it was, but some fellow had even said,

units.source_text: 没有比自己耳朵后面的污垢更美味的东西了，

en.t: there was nothing more delicious than the grime behind one's own ears,

units.source_text: 甚至比正宗的奶酪还好吃……
尽管没到那种程度，然而，蛀了的虫牙气味，

en.t: Though it was not to that extent, still, the smell of a decayed, worm-eaten tooth

units.source_text: 确实有一种蛊惑人的气味，怎么嗅都嗅不厌似的……

en.t: really did have a strangely seductive odor, as if one could sniff it forever without growing tired of it...
